gdpr.paragraphs: We process personal data based on your consent and for the purpose of handling your inquiry.
Data is retained only as long as necessary to fulfill the request and legal obligations.
You have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal data.
Data storage and processing comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

gdpr.sections.heading: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The data controller is Smíchov Living s.r.o. (hereinafter referred to as the 'Controller'). The Controller is responsible for processing personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council (GDPR) and Act No. 110/2019 Coll., on personal data processing.
Registered office: Kováků 456/28, Smíchov, 150 00 Prague 5, Czech Republic
Email: info@smichovliving.cz

gdpr.sections.heading: 2. What personal data we process
gdpr.sections.description: In connection with the operation of the website and handling your inquiries, we may process the following personal data:
list: information included in the inquiry text or other communication
IP address and technical details about the device and browser
data related to website usage and cookies
paragraphs: The scope of processed data depends on how you contact us and what information you voluntarily provide.

subsections.heading: Cookies and tracking
paragraphs: We use Google Analytics 4 through Google Tag Manager to understand how visitors use our site.
list: _ga – anonymous user identifier, retention about 2 years
_ga_xxx – session and event measurement, retention about 2 months
Cookies are set only after consent is given.

gdpr.sections.heading: 3. Purpose and legal basis of processing

columns: Handling inquiries and communication with the interested party
Measures prior to entering into a contract at the request of the data subject – Article 6(1)(b) GDPR
Fulfillment of contractual and legal obligations
Performance of a contract or legal obligation – Article 6(1)(b) or (c) GDPR
Protection of legal claims and security
Legitimate interest or consent depending on the specific purpose – Article 6(1)(a) or (f) GDPR

gdpr.sections.heading: 4. Retention period of personal data
paragraphs: We process personal data only for as long as is necessary to fulfill the purpose for which it was collected, or for the period required by law.

Data provided for handling an inquiry is retained only for the duration necessary to handle the inquiry and related communication. If the inquiry leads to a contractual relationship, data is retained for the duration of the contractual relationship and thereafter for the period required by applicable law.
Personal data related to potential legal claims may be retained for the duration of the relevant limitation periods.
After the applicable period expires, personal data is deleted or anonymized unless further retention is required by law.

gdpr.sections.heading: 5. Recipients of personal data
paragraphs: We may disclose your personal data to third parties who provide services related to website operation, electronic communication, and handling your requests.
list: web hosting and IT service providers
technical and analytics service providers if used on the website
accounting, tax or legal advisors if necessary
state authorities, if required by law

gdpr.sections.heading: 6. Transfer of personal data to third countries
paragraphs: If the personal data of our users is transferred outside the European Economic Area by our service providers, we do so only under GDPR conditions and with appropriate safeguards for personal data protection, such as an adequacy decision or standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.

gdpr.sections.heading: 7. Your rights
gdpr.sections.description: In connection with the processing of your personal data, you have the following rights:

subsections.heading: 7.1 Right of access
paragraphs: You have the right to obtain confirmation as to whether we process your personal data and, if so, access to that data.

subsections.heading: 7.2 Right to rectification
paragraphs: You have the right to request correction of inaccurate personal data and completion of incomplete data.

subsections.heading: 7.3 Right to erasure
paragraphs: Under GDPR conditions, you have the right to request deletion of your personal data.

subsections.heading: 7.4 Right to restriction of processing
paragraphs: Under GDPR conditions, you have the right to request restriction of processing of your personal data.

subsections.heading: 7.5 Right to data portability
paragraphs: Under GDPR conditions, you have the right to receive personal data you have provided in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.

subsections.heading: 7.6 Right to object
paragraphs: You have the right to object to processing based on legitimate interest, or to processing for direct marketing purposes.

subsections.heading: 7.7 Right to withdraw consent
paragraphs: If processing of your personal data is based on consent, you have the right to withdraw that consent at any time. Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.

gdpr.sections.heading: 8. How to exercise your rights
paragraphs: You can exercise your rights or submit inquiries regarding personal data protection by sending a request to info@smichovliving.cz or in writing to the Controller's registered office.
We will respond to your request without undue delay, and no later than one month after receiving it. In justified cases, this period may be extended in accordance with GDPR.

gdpr.sections.heading: 9. Right to lodge a complaint
paragraphs: If you believe that the processing of your personal data violates legal requirements, you have the right to file a complaint with the supervisory authority.

gdpr.sections.heading: 10. Security of personal data
paragraphs: We take appropriate technical and organizational measures to secure personal data and protect it against unauthorized or accidental access, alteration, destruction, loss, or other misuse.
These measures include securing data transmission, limiting access to personal data to authorized personnel only, and continuously updating the technical and security measures used.

gdpr.sections.heading: 11. Cookies
paragraphs: The website uses cookies and similar technologies. Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit websites.
Cookies may be used to ensure the basic functionality of the website, remember your preferences, and optionally measure traffic and improve the website.

Necessary cookies may be used without your consent if they are essential for providing a service you have explicitly requested. For other types of cookies, their use depends on your consent if required by law.

gdpr.sections.heading: 12. Automated decision-making and profiling
paragraphs: Your personal data is not subject to automated decision-making or profiling that would have legal effects on you or similarly significantly affect you.

gdpr.sections.heading: 13. Contact details
paragraphs: If you have any questions, comments or requests concerning personal data protection, you can contact us:

gdpr.sections.heading: 14. Final provisions
paragraphs: These personal data protection policies may be updated from time to time, especially in connection with changes in services used, processing methods or applicable legal regulations.
The current version of these policies is always available on the Smíchov Living website.
